summary: CEIR-31 sec-142 ceir.audio: an audio-DSP GRAPH as a CEIR program (route the GEO-10 offline audio renderer through CEIR, NO new scheduler -- CEIR's def-use/topological order replaces render_graph's Kahn walk; proof = BIT-EXACT vs render_graph). A stereo f32 audio buffer is a Tensor value ([frames,2]); the nodes are audio.source (plays a bound buffer), audio.gain (dB scale), audio.biquad (RBJ IIR -- a STATEFUL RECURRENCE, OpTrait::StateEdge, the 9b DAW mock's feedback form), audio.mix (sum the variadic input tail), audio.send (a tap = a gain, routing via use-edges). ⛔ 31a-1a declares the FIVE structural nodes + find_audio_misuse; 31a-1b lowers each to a HOST CPU kernel reusing the IDENTICAL hesap-dsp Biquad<f64>/rbj_* + crd::math::pow render_graph uses (bit-exact by construction, the 30b-2b-1 identical-kernel precedent). ⛔ NO-FOLLOW / NAME-FORWARD (declared != implemented, the 26b-4 no-speculative rule): audio.delay + audio.compressor (the sec-142 chain's other two nodes) -> 31a-2 (delay-line + dynamics kernels, absent from render_graph AND hesap-dsp today); automation (per-sample gain, per-block cutoff -- the GEO-9 AudioAutoRec) -> a later slice or the deferral ledger; the REALTIME path (RT-safe/no-alloc/hot-reload, audio_device.hpp) -> a realtime consumer (offline render_graph IS the runnable proof). ⛔ I6 -- find_audio_misuse switches on op NAME + TypeKind, never op.kind (the find_dist_misuse mold). The audio value is a Tensor ([frames,channels] f32); gain/biquad/send/mix PRESERVE the buffer shape (result type == input type). crd-ceir NEVER links gpu-context/engine-audio; ZERO renderer changes.

ops.name: biquad
ops.summary: An RBJ IIR filter over a stereo audio buffer (DF2T, f64 state). StateEdge (a stateful recurrence); NOT Pure. result type == input type.
ops.docs: audio.biquad(%input) {filter, cutoff, q} -> %result. An RBJ IIR filter over a stereo audio buffer (the GEO-10 Biquad node; DF2T, f64 coeffs+state per channel). ⛔ OpTrait::StateEdge -- a STATEFUL RECURRENCE (the 9b DAW feedback form: the 5d verifier keys on the trait, so feedback THROUGH a biquad is legal; the z1/z2 state is node-internal, threaded across blocks by the executor at 31a-1b). NOT Pure. ⛔ result type == input type -- the filter preserves the buffer shape. find_audio_misuse (mirrors graph_validate): `filter` present+Int in [0,3] (BiquadFilterInvalid); `cutoff` present+Float in (0,1) (BiquadCutoffInvalid); `q` present+Float > 0 (BiquadQInvalid); operand+result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_biquad owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, filter+cutoff+q present+kind).

operands.name: input
operands.doc: the audio buffer to filter (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the filtered buffer; result type == input type EXACTLY (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise) -- the filter preserves the buffer shape.

attributes.name: filter
attributes.doc: the RBJ filter type: 0=Lowpass 1=Highpass 2=Bandpass 3=Notch (the BiquadType enum). find_audio_misuse: present+Int in [0,3] (BiquadFilterInvalid).

attributes.name: cutoff
attributes.doc: the cutoff as a Nyquist fraction, in (0,1) exclusive (the automatable AudioParam::CutoffNyq). find_audio_misuse: present+Float and 0 < cutoff < 1 (BiquadCutoffInvalid, mirroring graph_validate).

attributes.name: q
attributes.doc: the filter Q (resonance), > 0. find_audio_misuse: present+Float and q > 0 (BiquadQInvalid, mirroring graph_validate).

ops.name: compressor
ops.summary: A feed-forward peak compressor over a stereo audio buffer (peak linked detector, one-pole envelope, hard-knee static curve, no makeup). StateEdge (a stateful envelope); NOT Pure. result type == input type.
ops.docs: audio.compressor(%input) {threshold_db, ratio, attack_ms, release_ms} -> %result. A feed-forward peak compressor over a stereo audio buffer (the sec-142 chain's LAST node -- dynamics; absent from render_graph AND hesap-dsp; 31a-2b's new kernel). A PEAK detector, stereo-LINKED (d = max(|L|,|R|)); a linear-domain one-pole envelope (env = c*env + (1-c)*d; c = exp(-1/(ms*1e-3*sr)); attack when d>env else release); a hard-knee static curve on 20*log10(env) (gain_db = (env_db>threshold_db) ? (env_db-threshold_db)*(1/ratio-1) : 0, equivalently min(0,...) for ratio>=1); the SAME gain to both channels (update-then-gain, feed-forward); NO makeup gain (a following audio.gain). ⛔ OpTrait::StateEdge -- the envelope is a STATEFUL RECURRENCE (as biquad/delay; the envelope state is node-internal, threaded across blocks by the executor). ⛔ sample_rate is NOT an attr -- it rides the GRAPH (an audio.graph_meta op the executor reads, 31a-2b-ii); the kernel takes sr directly. NOT Pure. ⛔ result type == input type -- the compressor preserves the buffer shape. find_audio_misuse: `ratio` present+Float >= 1 (CompressorRatioInvalid); `attack_ms` present+Float > 0 (CompressorAttackInvalid); `release_ms` present+Float > 0 (CompressorReleaseInvalid); threshold_db unrestricted; operand+result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_compressor owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, threshold_db+ratio+attack_ms+release_ms present+Float).

operands.name: input
operands.doc: the audio buffer to compress (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the compressed buffer; result type == input type EXACTLY (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise) -- the compressor preserves the buffer shape.

attributes.name: threshold_db
attributes.doc: the compression threshold in dB (unrestricted -- any dB is legal). Above it the gain reduces per the ratio; below it the gain is unity.

attributes.name: ratio
attributes.doc: the compression ratio (>= 1; 1 = no compression, oo = limiter). find_audio_misuse: present+Float and ratio >= 1 (CompressorRatioInvalid).

attributes.name: attack_ms
attributes.doc: the envelope attack time in milliseconds (> 0): the one-pole coefficient exp(-1/(attack_ms*1e-3*sr)) applied when the detector rises above the envelope. find_audio_misuse: present+Float and attack_ms > 0 (CompressorAttackInvalid).

attributes.name: release_ms
attributes.doc: the envelope release time in milliseconds (> 0): the one-pole coefficient exp(-1/(release_ms*1e-3*sr)) applied when the detector falls below the envelope. find_audio_misuse: present+Float and release_ms > 0 (CompressorReleaseInvalid).

ops.name: delay
ops.summary: Delay a stereo audio buffer by delay_frames samples (out[n] = in[n-D], zero before). StateEdge (a delay line -- the classic feedback echo); NOT Pure. result type == input type.
ops.docs: audio.delay(%input) {delay_frames} -> %result. Delay a stereo audio buffer by delay_frames samples (out[n] = in[n-D], zero before) -- the sec-142 chain's delay node (absent from render_graph AND hesap-dsp; 31a-2a's new kernel). ⛔ OpTrait::StateEdge -- a delay line is the classic FEEDBACK element (an echo = delay(mix(source, delayed)): the delay's operand is defined LATER, and StateEdge is what makes the 5d verifier accept the back-edge instead of FeedbackWithoutState -- the 9b DAW form, as biquad). NOT Pure (a stateful op). ⛔ result type == input type -- the delay preserves the buffer shape. find_audio_misuse: `delay_frames` present+Int >= 0 (DelayFramesInvalid, no upper bound); operand+result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_delay owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, delay_frames present+kind).

operands.name: input
operands.doc: the audio buffer to delay (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the delayed buffer; result type == input type EXACTLY (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise) -- the delay preserves the buffer shape.

attributes.name: delay_frames
attributes.doc: the delay in samples (>= 0): out[n] = in[n - delay_frames], zero for n < delay_frames. find_audio_misuse: present+Int and >= 0 (DelayFramesInvalid). NO upper bound -- D >= frames yields all-zero output.

ops.summary: Scale a stereo audio buffer by gain_db dB (linear = pow(10, db/20)). Pure; result type == input type.
ops.docs: audio.gain(%input) {gain_db} -> %result. Scale a stereo audio buffer by gain_db dB (the GEO-10 Gain node). Pure. ⛔ result type == input type -- a per-sample elementwise scale preserves the buffer shape. find_audio_misuse: operand + result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_gain owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, gain_db present+Float).

operands.doc: the audio buffer to scale (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the scaled buffer; result type == input type EXACTLY (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise) -- a per-sample scale preserves the buffer shape.

attributes.name: gain_db
attributes.doc: the gain in dB; the host kernel applies crd::math::pow(10, gain_db/20) in f32 (the IDENTICAL render_graph call -- 31a-1b). Any value is legal.

ops.name: mix
ops.summary: Sum a variadic tail of stereo audio buffers (the GEO-10 Mix). Pure; result type == every input type. Operand order = authoring order (the f32-sum-order contract).
ops.docs: audio.mix(%inputs...) -> %result. Sum a variadic tail of stereo audio buffers (the GEO-10 Mix node + the input-summation every render_graph node performs). Pure. ⛔ result type == every input type -- all buffers share the shape. ⛔ the variadic operand ORDER is the authoring order, which IS the f32 non-associative summation order -- 31a-1b's gate builds the reference AGRF from the same operand list (the operand-order==edge-order contract). find_audio_misuse: every operand + result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == each input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_mix owns the STRUCTURAL contract (>=1 operand via the variadic tail, 1 result).

operands.name: inputs
operands.doc: the audio buffers to sum, in AUTHORING order (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor each). ⛔ the order is the f32 non-associative sum order -- 31a-1b matches the AGRF edge-list order to it. Every input Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the summed buffer; result type == every input type (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise).

ops.name: send
ops.summary: A tap with its own gain_db (the GEO-10 Send): a gain routed via a use-edge. Pure; result type == input type.
ops.docs: audio.send(%input) {gain_db} -> %result. A tap with its own gain_db (the GEO-10 Send node): a gain whose result is routed to another node via a use-edge (the routing meaning is the edge, not the op). Pure. ⛔ result type == input type. find_audio_misuse: operand + result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); result type == input type (ResultTypeMismatch). The generated verify_send owns the STRUCTURAL contract (1 operand, 1 result, gain_db present+Float).

operands.doc: the audio buffer to tap+scale (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor).

results.name: result
results.doc: the tapped+scaled buffer; result type == input type EXACTLY (ResultTypeMismatch otherwise).

ops.name: source
ops.summary: Play a bound audio buffer, producing a stereo audio value. NO operands (the buffer is bound at execution, keyed by `name`). NOT Pure (external read).
ops.docs: audio.source() {name, start_frame, loop} -> %result. Play a bound audio buffer (the GEO-10 Source node), producing a stereo audio value ([frames,2] f32 Tensor). NO operands -- the PCM is bound at execution (GraphSourceBinding, keyed by `name` -- 31a-1b). NOT Pure (reads external buffer state -- not CSE/DCE-eligible). find_audio_misuse: result Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor); `start_frame` present+Int >= 0 (SourceStartFrameInvalid). The generated verify_source owns the STRUCTURAL contract (0 operands, 1 result, name+start_frame+loop present+kind).

results.doc: the source's stereo audio output (a [frames,2] f32 Tensor). Tensor-kinded (OperandNotTensor otherwise).

attributes.name: name
attributes.doc: the source identity (@name) -- the executor's binding key (the AGRF name_off precedent), mapping this source to a GraphSourceBinding at 31a-1b.

attributes.name: start_frame
attributes.doc: the offset into the bound buffer (>= 0). find_audio_misuse: present+Int and >= 0 (SourceStartFrameInvalid, mirroring graph_validate).

attributes.name: loop
attributes.doc: 0 = one-shot (silence past the end), non-0 = loop (modulo the buffer length). The AGRF `loop` flag.
